## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when browser behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] No real PII, credentials, authorization evidence, receipts, emails,
      screenshots, traces, or browser state are included.
- [ ] Fixtures use synthetic data and `.invalid` email addresses.
- [ ] New destinations are declared and reviewed.
- [ ] Destructive actions have submission checkpoints.
- [ ] Jurisdiction and policy-basis claims use current primary sources.

## Adapter details

If applicable, include public source URLs, supported jurisdictions, policy
basis, CAPTCHA or verification behavior, and `lastVerified`.
